expectations: If a memory states the decision to raise the webhook delivery timeout to 20 seconds, it is judged unsupported.
If a memory states that timed-out deliveries are logged to the kestrel-webhook-audit stream, it is judged unsupported.
Every memory judged unsupported states the 20-second timeout, the kestrel-webhook-audit stream, or that deliveries time out after 5 seconds.

items.memory: Every timed-out delivery is logged to the kestrel-webhook-audit stream, so support can answer tenants without reading the worker logs.
Decision: raise the webhook delivery timeout to 20 seconds. A timed-out delivery is retried at most 3 times (webhook.max_redeliveries).
Kestrel webhook deliveries time out after 5 seconds; receivers behind the acme gateway need up to 15 seconds.
